text:
Maya: Quick final check for tomorrow's webinar — registration page, Zoom settings, recording, and the post-event follow-up sequence. Need to lock co-host, recording layout, HubSpot routing, and follow-up copy.

Evan: Zoom invite sent to speakers. Meeting ID: 987654321, passcode set. Do we want waiting room on?

Priya: I'd prefer NO waiting room (reduces drop-off). Keep registration required + passcode in confirmation email only. Capture UTMs on the reg page. :+1:

Noah: Sales asks: flag "hot" leads (watch >30m or asked a Q). Can we push attendee events to HubSpot with a property like `webinar_engagement` so workflows can route?

Olivia: I'll co-host and manage Q&A/handoff. Set cloud recording: speaker view + auto-transcript. Also mark Q&A start in chat for highlight clips.

zoom-bot: Recording settings updated: Cloud Recording = ON | Auto-transcript = ON | Recording layout = Active Speaker

Maya: Post-event flow: upload recording + transcript + slides to GDrive Marketing/Webinars/2026-03-22, then send replay email with 2 CTAs (demo request / try free). Draft follow-up snippet below:

``
Thanks for joining our webinar on Serving LLMs at Scale — recording + slides attached.
Try Redwood with free credits: https://redwood.ai/trial?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=llm_inference_webinar_2026
Request a custom demo: https://redwood.ai/demo?utm_source=webinar

We'll also share a short Q&A highlight clip for SDR outreach.
``

Priya: Add UTM to every link (utm_campaign=llm_inference_webinar_2026). Two-email CTA strategy: Day 0 replay+slides, Day 3 case study, Day 7 demo invite. I'll own nurture series.

Noah: I'll take owner for hot leads. Workflow in HubSpot: if `webinar_engagement` >= 30 => assign owner Noah, push to #webinar-leads Slack, create task for SDR follow-up. Need test payload example for Zapier/HubSpot: 

``
{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "utm_source": "{{utm_source}}",
  "registered_at": "{{timestamp}}",
  "engagement_minutes": "{{watch_time_minutes}}"
}
``

Evan: Zoom admin note — enable "notify participants when recording starts" and set cloud recording auto-delete to 365 days (compliance). Also make Olivia a co-host.

Maya: We'll host registration on Typeform — make sure GA clientId is captured and passed to HubSpot for attribution. Also tag registrants with `source=webinar_mktg`.

Priya: For lead qualification: include a short question on registration about use-case (product/demo/opinion) so Sales can prioritize.

Noah: Can we auto-create a 30s highlight clip (top Q&A) for SDRs? That'd convert better than full recording.

Maya: Plan: upload full recording -> auto-generate 3x 2-min clips. Olivia to mark start/end timestamps in chat. After upload, trigger a small GH action to create clips and place them in GDrive.

Olivia: I'll mark Q&A start in-chat and paste timestamp. Also will add speaker notes for clip editors.

Evan: Checklist status: co-host ✅, cloud recording ✅, registration page live ✅, HubSpot webhook test ✅. Let's run one full rehearsal 30 minutes before start.

Maya: Perfect. @Noah I'll give you HubSpot access to the webinar workflow. @Priya sending the draft follow-up cadence for edits in 30m. Ping me if anything changes. :party_parrot:
